description: Source code for Prometheus client labels management, including label collections, constraints, validation, and related utilities.

classes.name: ConstrainedLabel
classes.description: Represents a label with a name and an optional constraint function for normalization.

classes.name: ConstrainableLabels
classes.description: Interface for label collections that can be compiled and provide label names.

classes.name: ConstrainedLabels
classes.description: Slice of ConstrainedLabel, representing a collection of constrained labels.

classes.name: UnconstrainedLabels
classes.description: Slice of strings representing label names without constraints.

classes.name: compiledLabels
classes.description: Internal structure holding label names and constraints, with methods for compilation, naming, and constraining labels.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles label collections into a form with label names and constraints.

methods.name: labelNames
methods.description: Returns the list of label names.

methods.name: constrain
methods.description: Applies label constraints to a value based on label name.
